text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the first Classic race—the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: This may only be the first race, but if I lose here, I can't become a Triple Crown champion.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It's fine. I got this… Victory is assured!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio's fixation on becoming Triple Crown champion seems to be making her feel the pressure right now.
choice_data_list: Focus on showing everyone how awesome you are!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …I get it. Winning here may be important, but the most important thing is to put on a performance I won't regret!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: My rivals, my fans, Prez… I need to surprise all of them. Show them what the great Teio can do!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Looks like my breathing is back to normal. Here I go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh, and just so you know… I'm still shooting for that Triple Crown title!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Prez took the Triple Crown throne with her overwhelming strength, and I want a taste of that same glory!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Leave it to the invincible Teio!
